posts.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
posts.description: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.

posts.title: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
posts.description: Almost one million customers in the US had no power on Thursday evening as storms descended on both US coasts, bringing wind gusts, heavy rain and flooding.

posts.title: Met Police ruined my life, says Kenyan man wrongly sentenced over attack on UK couple
posts.description: Evidence from a British police officer helped convict Ali Kololo over a 2011 attack in the Kenyan resort of Lamu.
